notes.title: Bomb Defense v.1.021 released
notes.content:
Version 1.021 bug fixes and changes:
Tutorial’s arrows will now get properly removed if you quit the tutorial early.
The tutorial text on some parts was improved.
The starting money of some levels was adjusted. Mostly for Gold and Silver difficulties.

Some of the previously released fixes since version 1.0:
Problems with the swinging mauls were fixed.
A few levels had some enemies stuck at their starting positions occasionally. That was fixed.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29247477/fa7eb428212d6b7065507d49f8391972a3dccaec.jpg[/img]
